## Name & positioning

- One-line value: HomePrep AI turns your home type and timeline into a prioritized prep checklist — what to fix, declutter, and stage before photos and showings — so the listing photographs well.

## FAQ
Q1. What is HomePrep AI?
A1. HomePrep AI is a tool that turns your home type and timeline into a prioritized prep checklist for photos and showings.
Q2. What does the checklist cover?
A2. What to fix, declutter, and stage, prioritized by impact on presentation.
Q3. Is it expensive to follow?
A3. The tips are budget-friendly, favoring low-cost prep over renovations.
Q4. Does it fit my schedule?
A4. It is timeline-based so the plan matches the days you have before photos.
Q5. Who should use it?
A5. Homeowners and agents who want a photo-ready prep plan without a full stager.
Q6. Does it help with before-photos?
A6. It includes before-photos tips so you capture the home at its best.
